video_title: The World's Worst Children 3 - Honey the Hogger

summaries.summary: Honey the hogger spends so long on her ridiculous beauty routine that nobody else can use the family’s only bathroom. She uses modeling clay as a mud mask, spaghetti as hair extensions, gravy to tan her skin, sticky tape to remove nasal hair, ice cream cones as an eye mask, and her brother Horus’s hamster to brush her eyebrows. Horus needs to pee every few minutes, so he often has to use emergency containers. Honey teases him by running taps or putting his fingers in warm water. One evening, she secretly adds hot chili powder to his dinner, then makes him drink many glasses of water. When Horus becomes desperate, Honey locks herself in the bathroom. He searches for a place to go, but cannot pee from the window because a cat is below. Finally, he bites through a water pipe and pees into it. The water floods the bathroom, and Honey flushes herself into the sewer, where she is trapped forever. Horus can now use the bathroom whenever he needs to.

video_title: The World's Worst Children 3 - Hank's Pranks

summaries.summary: Hank played a trick every day and shouted, “Gotcha!” He scared his grandmother with cream, frightened his sister Molly by pretending to be a shark, made his father eat cheese biscuits, sent Grandpa flying in roller-skate slippers, and put Aunt Katie’s gerbils in Uncle Tony’s remote-control planes. Hank’s mother disliked his tricks most. One night, while taking a bath, Hank planned his biggest trick. He wanted his mother to think he had stayed in the bath all night. Early in the morning, he drew lines on his body, filled the bath with ice, and climbed in. His mother, Molly, and his father came into the bathroom but did not look in the bath. Hank became very cold and blue. He climbed out, fell down the stairs, and landed at his mother’s feet. The family laughed and said, “Gotcha!” Later, they took Hank to hospital. He needed a week to warm up, and doctors had to remove his frozen swimming trunks.

video_title: The World's Worst Children 3 - Hank's Pranks

summaries.summary: Hank played a prank on someone every day and shouted, “Gotcha!” His family suffered most. He frightened Molly with a homemade shark costume, tricked his cheese-allergic father into eating chocolate-covered cheese, sent Grandpa flying in roller-skate slippers, and put Auntie Katie’s gerbils in Uncle Tony’s remote-control planes. His mother was especially nervous, so Hank planned his greatest prank. He would pretend to have stayed in the bath all night. Early one morning, he drew lines on his body to look like a prune, filled the bath with ice, and lay in the freezing water. His mother, Molly, and father entered the bathroom but did not look in the bath. Hank became blue and stiff with cold. When he finally escaped, he slipped down the stairs and landed at his mother’s feet. The family thought it was another prank and laughed, shouting, “Gotcha!” After hours, they realized he was truly ill. Hank went to hospital and took a week to recover. His swimming trunks had to be removed in an operation because they had frozen to him. The prank had ended up being on Hank.

video_title: The World's Worst Children 3 - Hank's Pranks

summaries.summary: Hank played a prank on someone every day and always shouted, “Gotcha!” His tricks upset his family, including his grandmother, sister Molly, father, grandfather, Uncle Tony, and Auntie Katie. His mother disliked the pranks most, so Hank planned his “masterpiece.” He decided to make her think he had spent the whole night in the bath. Early one morning, he put on swimming trunks and goggles, covered his skin with brown pen lines, filled the bath with ice, and climbed in. His mother, sister, and father entered the bathroom but never looked into the bath. Hank became extremely cold, turned blue, and could barely move. When he finally left the bath, he slipped down the stairs and landed at his mother’s feet. The family thought it was another prank and laughed, shouting, “Gotcha!” After several hours, they realized something was wrong and took him to hospital. Hank needed a week to recover and an operation to remove his frozen swimming trunks. The prank had ended badly for him.

video_title: The World's Worst Children 3 - Fanny's Funny Faces

summaries.summary: Fanny loved making funny faces and used them to frighten people outside her home. She scared a vicar, an old lady and her dog, and everyone at her school by pretending to be sick. Her angry father told her, “One day the wind will change and you will get stuck like that.” One morning, Fanny made her best face, called the “bottom faced girl,” and went to London. People ran away when they saw her. At the Royal Opera House, she frightened the singer Luigi Lancelotti, who sang the wrong note and was covered with rotten fruit. At 10 Downing Street, she scared Larry the cat, a policeman, and the Prime Minister. The policeman accidentally arrested the Prime Minister. At Buckingham Palace, Fanny frightened the Queen. The Queen spat tea, and Fanny fell from a ladder into wet cement. The cement hardened around her. Fanny became a statue in London, with her face stuck forever.

video_title: The World's Worst Children 3 - Fanny's Funny Faces

summaries.summary: Fanny loved pulling funny faces and used them to shock people outside her home. She frightened a vicar into climbing his church spire, scared an old lady and her dog away, and fooled her school into believing she had a contagious disease. Her furious father ordered her to stop and warned that one day her face might stay that way. Later, Fanny created her finest face, the “bottom faced girl,” by puffing out her cheeks and pursing her lips. Proud of it, she traveled to London. On the train, at the Royal Opera House, and outside 10 Downing Street, her face frightened passengers, an opera singer, Larry the cat, a policeman, and the Prime Minister. The Prime Minister was accidentally arrested and resigned. At Buckingham Palace, Fanny startled the Queen, fell from a ladder, and landed in wet cement. The cement hardened around her, so she became a statue in London as a warning to naughty children.

video_title: The World's Worst Children 3 - Fanny's Funny Faces

summaries.summary: Fanny collected funny faces and loved using them to shock people. She frightened a vicar, sent an old woman and her dog far across the countryside, and made her school believe she had a contagious disease. Her angry father ordered her to stop, warning that one day the wind might change and leave her face stuck that way. Soon afterward, Fanny created her greatest face, the “bottom faced girl,” by puffing out her cheeks and pursing her lips. She took it to London, where frightened passengers cleared a train. At the Royal Opera House, her appearance caused Luigi Lancelotti to sing a wrong note. At 10 Downing Street, Larry the cat and a policeman caused the Prime Minister to be arrested by mistake. At Buckingham Palace, Fanny frightened the Queen, fell from a ladder, and landed in wet cement. It hardened around her, so she became a statue in London, with her face stuck forever.

video_title: The World's Worst Children 3 - Bonnie Bossypants

summaries.summary: Bonnie was very bossy. She told her classmates, teachers, mother, father, and little brother Benji what to do. One night, she made Father eat peas and sent her parents to their room. Her parents asked Wonder Nanny, a television star who helps with naughty children, to come. Wonder Nanny arrived with her TV team and told Bonnie to sit on the naughty step. Bonnie refused until Wonder Nanny showed her a huge tarantula, because Bonnie was afraid of spiders. Bonnie sat quietly for an hour while Benji hit her with his yo-yo. Wonder Nanny taught Bonnie’s parents ways to stop the bossing. She left the tarantula with the family, and Benji said his first words: he loved spiders. He named it Bossy Pants. After Bonnie’s television show aired, she learned that Wonder Nanny was afraid of cheese. Bonnie filled Wonder Nanny’s car with smelly cheese. Wonder Nanny became sick, so Bonnie ran home. Then Wonder Nanny sent hundreds of spiders to Bonnie’s house.

video_title: The World's Worst Children 3 - Bonnie Bossypants

summaries.summary: Bonnie Bollington bosses everyone around, including her classmates, teachers, parents, and silent ten-year-old brother Benji. When she threatens to force peas up her father’s nose, her parents decide to ask Wonder Nanny for help. Wonder Nanny arrives with a television crew and makes Bonnie sit on the naughty step by threatening her with a tarantula, her greatest fear. She also teaches Bonnie’s parents ways to control their daughter’s bossiness. Benji is put in charge and finally speaks when he says that he loves spiders. Bonnie later watches her episode on television and decides to get revenge because Wonder Nanny has embarrassed her. She collects smelly cheese and secretly fills Wonder Nanny’s Bentley with it. Wonder Nanny finds the cheese, becomes sick, and Bonnie escapes laughing. However, Wonder Nanny sends Bonnie a box filled with hundreds of spiders. Benji lets many of them sleep with Bonnie, leaving the bossy girl terrified.

video_title: The World's Worst Children 3 - Bonnie Bossypants

summaries.summary: Bonnie is extremely bossy and orders around her classmates, teachers, and family. At dinner, she threatens her father because he will not eat his peas, then sends her parents to their room and makes Benji clean up. Unable to cope, Bonnie’s parents contact Wonder Nanny, a television expert who corrects naughty children. The next morning, Wonder Nanny arrives with a producer and camera crew. She makes Bonnie sit on the naughty step by threatening her with a tarantula, because Bonnie is terrified of spiders. Benji, who has never spoken, becomes responsible for keeping Bonnie quiet and finally says that he loves spiders. Wonder Nanny teaches the parents other ways to control Bonnie’s bossiness and leaves the tarantula with the family. After Bonnie’s episode appears on television, she learns that Wonder Nanny fears cheese. Bonnie fills the woman’s car with smelly cheese, making her sick. In revenge, Wonder Nanny sends hundreds of spiders, which Benji lets sleep with Bonnie.

video_title: The World's Worst Children 3 - Boastful Barnabus

summaries.summary: Barnabas was a rich boy at St Cubert’s school who loved to boast. He bragged about his high test marks, winning cricket captain, and starring in the school play. Each time he boasted, his head grew bigger, but Barnabas did not notice. His teacher, Mr Harel, warned him, but Barnabas sent him away. On prize-giving day, Barnabas won prize after prize, and his head grew as large as an igloo. He was angry when Twiin won the chess prize because Barnabas had never attended chess club. At last, the Headmaster announced the new head boy. Barnabas hurried to the stage while carrying all his cups and trophies. He fell, and the tiny sword on the drama trophy stuck in his huge forehead. Twiin pulled it out. Barnabas’s head popped like a balloon, sending him flying through the school hall and out the window. He exploded over the cricket field. Mr Harel woke briefly, and Mr Pertwee said that the new head boy had become so bigheaded that he exploded.

video_title: The World's Worst Children 3 - Boastful Barnabus

summaries.summary: Barnabas is a wealthy pupil at St Cubert’s, an old and expensive school. He constantly boasts, such as bragging about scoring 99% while Twiin failed. Each time Barnabas boasts, his head grows slightly, but he does not notice. He becomes cricket captain and dismisses the other players so he can play every position. In the school play, Hamlet, he sends away the other actors and tries to perform every role himself. At prize giving, Barnabas wins nearly every award, so his head expands to an enormous size while he carries too many trophies. Twiin wins the chess prize because Barnabas never attended chess club, and Barnabas angrily calls him a cheat. Finally, the headmaster announces the new head boy. Barnabas rushes forward, trips, and falls onto a trophy’s tiny sword, which sticks in his swollen forehead. Twiin pulls it out, and Barnabas’s head pops like a balloon, sending him flying through a window and exploding over the cricket field.

video_title: The World's Worst Children 3 - Boastful Barnabus

summaries.summary: Barnabas is a wealthy pupil at St Cubert’s, an expensive English boarding school, and he constantly boasts about being better than everyone else. Whenever he boasts, his head grows slightly larger, but he does not notice. He mocks Twiin for failing mathematics, complains when his top hat becomes too small, and dismisses Mr Harel’s warning that his head is growing. Barnabas becomes cricket captain and fires the other players so he can play every position. He also takes every role in Hamlet and writes a glowing review of himself. At prize-giving, Barnabas wins award after award, causing his head to swell to an enormous size. Twiin wins the chess prize because Barnabas never attended chess club, and Barnabas angrily calls him a cheat. Barnabas is then named head boy, but he trips while carrying his trophies. A small sword from a trophy pierces his forehead. When Twiin pulls it out, Barnabas’s head bursts like a balloon, sending him through a window and into the sky.

video_title: The World's Worst Children 2 - No No Noe

summaries.summary: A little girl named No No says only “no.” She enjoys making her parents, teachers, and other people upset. At school, she throws a milkshake near Headmaster Mr Gubbins and refuses every order, so he becomes very angry. Her teachers also have trouble because she says no to everything. Caretaker Mr Potts wants to help. At a shop, newsagent Raj tricks No No by asking a question with many “not” words. She cannot work out the answer and runs away. Mr Potts tells the teachers, and they make a plan. They change school signs and ask No No questions filled with “not” and “no.” No No becomes confused and frustrated. At last, Mr Gubbins asks if she wants them to stop. She says, “Yes!” Everyone cheers and has a party. Later, Mr Gubbins asks if she is pleased. No No says no as a joke, and he happily says he loves “yes.” Fireworks spell “Yes.”

video_title: The World's Worst Children 2 - No No Noe

summaries.summary: No no is a little girl who only says “no,” because she enjoys making people frustrated. At home, she refuses every request from her parents. At school, she throws a half-full milkshake at Headmaster Mr Gubbins, then refuses to clean it up or accept detention. Her behavior has already caused several teachers great trouble. Caretaker Mr Potts decides to make her say “yes.” At a newsagent’s shop, Raj tricks No no by asking questions filled with many “not”s, and she runs away. Potts tells Mr Gubbins, who organizes the whole school. Potts changes school signs by adding many “not”s, and everyone asks No no confusing questions. Unable to decide how to answer, she becomes furious and hides in her English classroom. The teachers continue questioning her until Mr Gubbins asks whether she wants them to stop. She finally says “yes,” and the school celebrates with sweets, dancing, and fireworks spelling “YES.”

video_title: The World's Worst Children 2 - No No Noe

summaries.summary: No no was a girl who said only “no,” enjoying the chaos it caused at home and school. After she threw a half-full chocolate milkshake at Headmaster Mr Gubbins’s shoes, she refused every order and received detention, double detention, and exclusion. He became furious until caretaker Mr Pots carried him away. No’s refusals had already driven several teachers to extreme actions. At a newsagent, Raj confused her with repeated questions containing many “not”s about licorice allsorts, so she ran away. Pots told Gubbins, and they changed the school signs and planned a trick. On Monday, everyone asked No confusing questions. Overwhelmed, she fled to her classroom, where the teachers continued. When Gubbins asked whether she wanted them to stop, she finally said “yes.” The school celebrated with sweets, music, and fireworks spelling “Yes.” No then admitted she was joking and still liked “no,” while Gubbins happily repeated “yes.”

video_title: The World's Worst Children 2 - Trish The Troll

summaries.summary: Trish lived high in a block of flats. She liked to pretend she could squish people far below. At school, she wrote mean words about Megan on the toilet wall. A big wart appeared on Trish’s nose. The next day, she painted mean words about Cheryl on the school wall, and she grew huge furry ears. Then she wrote something nasty about Paul, and her hands became claws. In history class, Trish wrote that Thomas was a thicko. She grew fangs, fur, and big toes. Everyone saw that she had turned into a troll. Megan and Cheryl said Trish had written the cruel words. Trish broke through the door and ran away. The teachers, children, and people outside chased her. She escaped through a window, ran through the woods, and hid in a churchyard. At night, the mob found her. Trish ran, fell into a river, and floated to the sea. She reached a tiny island, where she lived alone in a small cave, completely squished.

video_title: The World's Worst Children 2 - Trish The Troll

summaries.summary: Trish lives high above the city and enjoys pretending to squish people between her fingers. At school, she decides that writing cruel messages might squish people for real. She writes “Megan’s got dog bog breath” on a toilet wall, and Megan cries. A wart appears on Trish’s nose. The next morning, Trish paints “Cheryl has a massive bum” on the school building, making Cheryl upset, while Trish grows huge furry ears. She then writes “Paul’s got a pizza face,” and her hands become claws. During history class, Trish scratches “Thomas is a thicko” onto her desk. Her teeth turn into fangs, fur covers her back, and her feet become monstrous. The class realizes she has become a troll and that she wrote the nasty messages. Trish escapes through the school, but teachers, pupils, and townspeople chase her. She reaches a churchyard, then flees from Miss Burch’s musket, falls into a river, and floats out to sea. She reaches a tiny island, where she lives alone in a cramped cave, “unhappily ever after.”

video_title: The World's Worst Children 2 - Trish The Troll

summaries.summary: Trish lived at the top of a tall block of flats and enjoyed pretending to squish people far below. At school, she saw cruel graffiti and decided to write something nasty herself. She wrote “Megan’s got dog bog breath,” although it was untrue. Megan cried, and a wart appeared on Trish’s nose. The next day, Trish painted “Cheryl has a massive bum” on the school wall. Cheryl cried, while Trish’s ears became huge and furry. Trish then wrote “Paul’s got a pizza face,” causing hair and claws to grow on her hands. During history class, she scratched “Thomas is a thicko” onto her desk. Her teeth became fangs, her body grew fur, and she turned into a troll. Megan and Cheryl realized Trish had written the insults. Trish escaped through the school, but teachers, pupils, and others chased her. She fled into a churchyard, then fell into a river and floated to sea. She reached a tiny island, where she lived alone in a cramped cave, truly squished.

video_title: The World's Worst Children 2 - Stacey Superstar

summaries.summary: Stacy Clog believes she will become the greatest singer ever. She dreams of albums, awards, a movie, and a museum about herself. But Stacy has no singing talent. Her terrible singing makes people hide, objects break, trees fall, and birds drop from the sky. Stacy still thinks everyone else is wrong, so she enters the TV talent show The Ego Factor. Her worried father secretly replaces her music with a famous singer’s recording and turns off her microphone. The judges and audience cheer because they think Stacy has a beautiful voice. Then Stacy steps on the music player, and the recording repeats “love” again and again. Everyone discovers the trick and boos. Stacy sings without music anyway. Her awful voice makes Tyson Trow’s wig fly off, cracks the ceiling, drops a chandelier, and causes the theater to collapse. Stacy becomes famous as the world’s worst singer. Her father digs her out of the rubble. Stacy’s first question is whether she reached the next round.

video_title: The World's Worst Children 2 - Stacey Superstar

summaries.summary: Stacy Clog believes she is destined to become the greatest singer ever, even though her singing is painfully awful. Whenever she practices, disasters happen: people flee, animals escape, objects break, and even trees fall. Stacy’s parents spend their money on lessons, but she never improves. Stacy enters the television talent show The Ego Factor, despite her parents’ warnings. Her father secretly replaces her backing track with a recording of a professional singer and disconnects her microphone, so everyone thinks Stacy is wonderful. However, the CD gets stuck repeating “love,” and the audience realizes the trick. Judge Tyson Trow asks Stacy to sing without music. She does, causing unbearable noise that damages the theater. The building collapses, and Stacy becomes famous as the world’s worst singer. Her father digs through the rubble and rescues her. Covered in dust, Stacy asks whether she has reached the next round.

video_title: The World's Worst Children 2 - Stacey Superstar

summaries.summary: Stacy Clog believes she is destined to become the greatest singer in history, even though her singing is painfully awful. Her lessons cause disasters: people flee, animals escape, objects break, trees fall, and birds drop from the sky. Stacy remains certain that everyone else is wrong, so she enters the TV talent show The Ego Factor. Her parents warn her, and her father sells the family car to buy her a huge gown. At the audition, judge Tyson Trow and the audience laugh at Stacy’s enormous confidence. Her father secretly plays a famous singer’s recording and disconnects Stacy’s microphone, making the audience think she has a wonderful voice. However, the CD sticks on the word “love,” exposing the trick. Stacy then sings for real. Her terrible voice damages the theater, sends the audience running, and causes the building to collapse during the live broadcast. Stacy becomes famous as the world’s worst singer. After her father rescues her from the rubble, she asks whether she reached the next round.

video_title: The World's Worst Children 2 - Spoiled Brad

summaries.summary: Brad Junior was a very spoiled boy who lived with Mom and Pop in a huge mansion. They gave him everything he wanted, but he broke, wasted, or threw away his gifts. Brad wanted his birthday to happen every day, so Mom and Pop held party after party. Each day had exciting shows, giant cakes, and more presents, but Brad always demanded more. He even made the guests wear headphones or blindfolds so only he could enjoy some of the fun. When a child said it was his birthday too, Brad had security guards carry him away. At the next party, Mom and Pop gave Brad thousands of presents and a cake as big as a swimming pool. Brad climbed onto the presents and jumped into the cake. He ate and ate, then began sinking into it. He cried for help, but Mom, Pop, and Butler Hopkins did not rescue him. Brad disappeared in the cake. The story says not to be too greedy.

video_title: The World's Worst Children 2 - Spoiled Brad

summaries.summary: Brad Junior is a very spoiled boy who lives with his wealthy Mom and Pop in a huge mansion. He wastes everything they give him, including puppies, a limousine, a robot, books, and valuable antiques. After his million-dollar birthday party, Brad demands that every day be his birthday. When his parents agree, they hold enormous parties with shows, rides, giant cakes, and thousands of presents. Brad still complains that the cakes and gifts are not big enough. At one party, another child says it is also his birthday, so Brad has him removed and demands double presents. The next celebration includes a giant net of gifts and a cake the size of a swimming pool. Brad climbs onto the presents and jumps into the cake. Because he has eaten so much cake and has become very round, he sinks into it. Mom, Pop, and butler Hopkins do not rescue him, and Brad disappears. The story warns that greed can lead to disaster.

video_title: The World's Worst Children 2 - Spoiled Brad

summaries.summary: Brad Junior is a spoiled boy whose wealthy parents buy him anything he wants. He quickly ruins or abandons his gifts, including puppies, a limousine, a robot, encyclopedias, and expensive antiques. After his million-dollar birthday party, Brad demands that every day be his birthday. When his parents agree, they hold enormous parties with rides, shows, mountains of presents, and giant chocolate cakes. Brad refuses to share anything and even has a child removed for saying it is his own birthday. Each day, Brad demands more presents and more cake. At the next party, a crane lowers thousands of gifts, and a cake the size of a swimming pool is brought in. Brad climbs onto the presents and dives into the cake, then greedily eats while trying to stay afloat. Because he is sinking in the cake, he cries for help. His parents and butler do not rescue him, and Brad disappears. The story warns that greed can lead to disaster.

video_title: The World's Worst Children 2 - Humbert the Hungry Baby

summaries.summary: Humbert was a huge baby when he was born. He broke the hospital scales, flattened his pram, and had to go home in a forklift truck. At home, he broke his cot and needed his parents’ bed. Humbert cried whenever he stopped drinking milk, so he ate more and grew bigger. One night, he emptied the fridge and larder. When his parents put the food on a high shelf, he used a pot, a cookbook, and the family cat, Marmalade, to reach it. He ate all the food and swallowed Marmalade too. Then Humbert ate his mother, but he spat out his father because of the mustard on his pajamas. He grew into a giant, broke through the house, and ate an ambulance, a poodle, a bus, police cars, and many things in the city. He chased his father up a tall building and ate a helicopter and two fighter jets. When he tried to eat the third jet, he fell and disappeared. The story says never eat three fighter jets at once.

video_title: The World's Worst Children 2 - Humbert the Hungry Baby

summaries.summary: Humbert is born so large that the hospital scales break, his mother is squashed, and his pram is flattened. His parents take him home in a forklift truck, but he bursts through his cot and sleeps across their bed. Humbert is always hungry. He drinks bottle after bottle of milk, eats the food in the fridge, and grows bigger. His father puts the remaining food on a high shelf, but Humbert builds a tower from a pot, a cookbook, and Marmalade the cat. He eats everything, including the tins and, when mustard leaves a bad taste, Marmalade. The next day, Humbert accidentally eats his mother and grows into a giant. His father escapes as Humbert destroys the house, eats an ambulance, and chases him through the city. Humbert consumes animals, vehicles, buildings, and a helicopter. On a skyscraper roof, he eats two fighter jets, loses his balance, and falls. The story ends by saying that two fighter jets are more than enough for one meal.

video_title: The World's Worst Children 2 - Humbert the Hungry Baby

summaries.summary: Humbert is born so enormous that the hospital scales break, his pram is flattened, and his parents must take him home in a forklift. He soon destroys his cot and takes over his parents’ bed. Humbert constantly demands milk and food, growing larger each time he eats. His parents try to protect their supplies by putting food on a high shelf, but Humbert builds a tower from a pot, cookbook, and the cat Marmalade to reach it. He eats nearly everything, then apparently swallows Marmalade and his mother. After growing taller than the house, Humbert eats furniture, breaks through the walls, destroys an ambulance, and chases his father through the streets. He devours a poodle, its owner, a tree, a bus, police cars, city objects, and a helicopter. On a skyscraper roof, he swallows two fighter jets but loses his balance while reaching for the third. He falls, and the hungry baby is no more. The story ends by saying that two fighter jets are enough for one meal.

video_title: The World's Worst Children 2 - Harry, Who Never, Ever Did His Homework

summaries.summary: Harry hates homework and always gives teachers silly excuses for not doing it. He spends his free time playing computer games instead. One day, a new history teacher named Madame Magna tells Harry to write about the greatest villain in world history. She warns that apparitions may visit him if he does not do it. Harry ignores her and plays games until bedtime. During the night, five smoky figures appear in his room: Attila the Hun, Vlad the Impaler, Caligula, Robespierre, and Genghis Khan. They say they are the greatest villains in history, but they do not hurt Harry. Instead, they make him do his homework and tell him about their terrible deeds. By morning, Harry has finished his first assignment. Madame Magna is very pleased when he hands it in. When Harry says it was a one-time event, she summons Boudicca in a terrifying chariot. Harry promises to do his homework. From then on, he always does it.

video_title: The World's Worst Children 2 - Harry, Who Never, Ever Did His Homework

summaries.summary: Harry hates homework and spends all his time playing computer games. He has many ridiculous excuses for missing assignments, but his teachers have stopped believing him. Then Madame Magna, a mysterious new history teacher, warns that he may be visited by apparitions if he does not complete his homework. That night, Harry ignores his essay about the greatest villain in world history and goes to sleep. Five terrifying figures appear in his room: Attila the Hun, Vlad the Impaler, Caligula, Robespierre, and Genghis Khan. Instead of hurting Harry, they force him to write his essay and tell him about their cruel deeds. Harry finishes by saying they were all equally bad. In the morning, Madame Magna praises his work. When Harry says it was a one-time event, she summons Boudicca in a deadly chariot. Frightened, Harry agrees to do his homework. From then on, he always completes it.

video_title: The World's Worst Children 2 - Harry, Who Never, Ever Did His Homework

summaries.summary: Harry hates homework and invents ridiculous excuses so he can spend all his time playing computer games. After years of refusing to work, he meets his new history teacher, the mysterious Madame Magna. She warns that apparitions may visit him if he does not complete his homework. That night, Harry ignores an essay about the greatest villain in world history and goes to sleep. Five ghosts then appear: Attila the Hun, Vlad the Impaler, Caligula, Robespierre, and Genghis Khan. They argue about who was worst, but they force Harry to write his essay using facts about their crimes. Harry concludes that they were equally bad. In the morning, he gives the essay to Madame Magna, who praises it. When Harry says he will not do homework again, she summons Boudicca in a terrifying chariot. Frightened, Harry agrees to work. From then on, he always does his homework.

video_title: The World's Worst Children 2 - Fussy Frankie

summaries.summary: Frankie was a very fussy eater. He refused all fruit and vegetables and ate only crisps, sweets, biscuits, cake, and chocolate. His worried Mom decided he must eat fruit and vegetables with every meal. She offered him grapefruit, banana, pineapple, cauliflower, peas, a pear, cabbage, and rhubarb. Frankie tricked her each time. He threw the food out of the window and took chocolate as a reward. The food landed at the nearby nuclear power station, which began flashing and smoking. At bedtime, Mom discovered the trick and sent Frankie to bed without chocolate. That night, a giant glowing cabbage tapped on his window. It said the fruits and vegetables had feelings and wanted revenge. Frankie ran outside, but the cabbage, cauliflower, peas, grapefruit, banana, pear, pineapple, and rhubarb chased him. The rhubarb caught him, and the fruits and vegetables ate him. The story ends with this lesson: eat your greens, or one day they might eat you.

video_title: The World's Worst Children 2 - Fussy Frankie

summaries.summary: Frankie is a very fussy eater who refuses all fruit and vegetables, especially rhubarb. He eats crisps, sweets, biscuits, cake, and chocolate instead. Worried about his health, his mother begins serving fruit and vegetables with every meal and promises him chocolate as a reward. Frankie pretends to eat grapefruit, banana, pineapple, cauliflower, peas, pear, and cabbage, but secretly throws them out of the window toward the nuclear power station beside their house. The power station grows hotter and begins flashing warning lights. When Frankie throws the rhubarb, his mother catches him and sends him to bed without chocolate. That night, the discarded foods become huge, glowing creatures after entering the power station. They chase Frankie through the town. The rhubarb claims revenge for all rhubarb and attacks him, while the other fruits and vegetables join in. Frankie disappears in their feeding frenzy. The story ends by warning children to eat their greens, or the greens might eat them.

video_title: The World's Worst Children 2 - Fussy Frankie

His worried mother decides he must have fresh food at every meal. Frankie agrees only because she promises chocolate, but he secretly throws grapefruit, a banana, pineapple, cauliflower, peas, a pear, and a cabbage out of the window toward the nearby nuclear power station. The power station begins flashing and overheating. When Frankie throws the rhubarb, his mother catches him and sends him to bed without chocolate. That night, a giant glowing cabbage taps on his window. It says the discarded vegetables entered the nuclear reactor and gained strange powers. The cabbage, peas, grapefruit, banana, pear, pineapple, cauliflower, and rhubarb chase Frankie through the town. He promises to eat his five a day, but the rhubarb claims revenge. The fruits and vegetables attack and eat Frankie. The story ends by warning children to eat their greens, or the greens might eat them.

video_title: The World's Worst Children 2 - Gruesome Griselda

summaries.summary: Griselda loved worms, slugs, spiders, and other creepy crawlies. At The Duchess of Queensbury School, she looked different from the tidy girls because she had messy hair, dirty nails, and a bad smell. She played tricks on everyone. She put leeches in Lady Clarissa’s bed, caterpillars in Miss Fragrant’s underwear, and slugs in sandwiches served to the Queen. The Queen spat out her sandwich, and the school searched for the person making the horrible tricks. Griselda kept collecting creatures and stored them in a large trunk. She planned her biggest trick: filling Miss Fragrant’s bath with creepy crawlies. At night, she emptied the bath, poured in the creatures, and filled it to the top. But when Miss Fragrant opened the door, it knocked Griselda into the bath. The creatures covered her, and only her purple hair scrunchie was left. The story says not to play tricks on people that you would not want played on you.

She then planned her biggest prank: filling Head Mistress Miss Fragrant’s bath with creepy crawlies. At night, Griselda emptied the trunk into the bath while Miss Fragrant prepared for her bath. However, the bathroom door knocked Griselda into the tub. The creatures covered and devoured her, leaving only her purple hair scrunchie. The story ends by stating that people should not play tricks on others that they would not want played on themselves.

video_title: The World's Worst Children 2 - Cruel Clarissa

summaries.summary: Clarissa looked like a sweet little girl. She wore pink clothes, played with pink toys, and pleased her parents and grandparents. Secretly, she was cruel to cats. She had teased many local cats, so she asked her parents for a kitten. Her parents believed she was kind and gave her a white kitten with blue eyes named Blossom. When they left, Clarissa’s sweet voice changed, and she began tormenting Blossom with loud music, tricks, costumes, and dangerous games. One night, Blossom escaped and found the local cats meeting under the moon. She told them what Clarissa had done. The cats recognized Clarissa as their tormentor and planned revenge. The next night, they covered Clarissa while she slept. She ran to the pond to make them let go and stayed in the cold water until morning. Her parents chased the cats away. Clarissa learned not to hurt cats. The Tom Cat took Blossom to a loving family. For her next birthday, Clarissa asked for a bunny.

When her parents leave, Clarissa’s sweet voice disappears, and she hurts Blossom in many ways, including making her listen to loud music, sending her down stairs, and letting dogs chase her. One night, Blossom escapes through a window and joins the local cats at their meeting. She tells the old Tom Cat about Clarissa’s cruelty, and the cats plan revenge. The next night, they cover Clarissa while she sleeps. She runs to the pond to escape them, but falls into the cold water and remains there until morning. Her parents rescue her, and Clarissa learns never to torment cats again. Blossom goes to a loving family, and Clarissa asks for a bunny.

video_title: The World's Worst Children 2 - Competitive Colin

summaries.summary: Colin Clun hated being short and wanted to be the winner at everything. He cheated in games, races, exams, and football, using tricks such as glue, a motorbike, cement, and a hidden helper. He filled his bedroom with trophies and became famous. Lord Sock, head of the British Olympic team, asked Colin to run in the 100-meter race at the Olympic Games in Tokyo. Colin agreed, then made huge rocket-propelled shoes so he could win. At the race, one shoe’s rocket went off late. Colin spun across the track, knocked down the other runners, and then flew into the air. He landed on Ike Scarper, the fastest runner, just before Ike reached the finish line. Colin crossed first, so officials gave him the gold, silver, and bronze medals. The crowd booed because he had ruined the race. People threw rotten fruit at him, so Colin stayed alone in his dark bedroom, still admiring his medals.

He cheats at games, quizzes, races, exams, football, and other contests, then fills his bedroom trophy cabinet with prizes. His tricks make him famous, so Lord Sock, head of the British Olympic team, asks Colin to replace an injured runner in the 100-meter sprint. Colin agrees and secretly builds rocket-propelled shoes with wheels and fireworks. At the Olympic stadium in Tokyo, Lord Sock worries about Colin’s strange shoes, but Colin enters the race. One fuse fails, sending Colin crashing into other runners. The second firework launches him into the air, and he lands on Ike Scarper, the fastest runner, just before the finish line. Colin is declared the winner and receives the gold, silver, and bronze medals because the other runners have fallen. However, the crowd boos him, and people everywhere call him a cheat. Colin stays alone in his dark bedroom, still admiring his medals and calling himself the best.

video_title: The World's Worst Children - Windy Mindy

summaries.summary: Windy Mindy is a little girl who can make many kinds of loud and smelly bottom noises. She enjoys causing trouble. At school, her noises interrupt lessons, make teachers leave, and send her to the head mistress. After Mindy makes another terrible smell, the head mistress warns that she will be expelled. Mindy hides in the music room and tries the instruments. She discovers that her wind can play a tuba. Music teacher Mr Tinkle hears her and thinks she is a musical genius. He gives her a new tuba and helps plan a concert at the Royal Albert Hall. Mindy practices every day and eats windy foods before the concert. She bounces on a trampoline, making even more gas. At the concert, she plays beautiful music through the tuba, but her smell makes the audience pass out. Her gas will not stop, so it blasts her through the roof and into space. No one sees Windy Mindy again.

Mindy cannot stop the gas, which launches her through the roof and into space. The astronauts see her, and that is the last sighting of Windy Mindy.

video_title: The World's Worst Children - Sofia Sofa

summaries.summary: Sofia Sofa spends all day and night sitting on the sofa and watching television. She does not go to school, help her mom, or eat at the table. She eats crisps, biscuits, cake, sweets, and chocolate while watching, so her mom must keep buying food. Sofia even asks her mom to change channels. One day, Mom tries to pull her up, but Sofia is stuck to the sofa. Dad, Mom, and many neighbors pull together, but she will not move. They call an ambulance. A crane breaks open the house and lifts Sofia, but she is too large for the ambulance. The driver ties her behind it and plugs in her television. On the way, a sharp turn breaks the rope and cable. Sofia flies through a television shop window and lands inside a giant television. She becomes one third girl, one third sofa, and one third television.

video_title: The World's Worst Children - Peter Picker

summaries.summary: Peter Picker loves picking his nose and saving the green bogies in a growing ball. He wants to beat Frine Schim’s world record for the biggest bogey, so he skips school and keeps adding more snot. The ball becomes a huge Snot Sphere. It grows so heavy that it breaks through Peter’s house and rolls down the street. Because it is sticky, it picks up a cat, people, animals, vehicles, trees, houses, and a bus. Peter runs away and hides in a drain while the Snot Sphere rolls past. It continues across the land, picking up a fire engine, shops, cows, and even Peter’s school. The sphere grows as large as the moon and rolls around Earth, collecting famous buildings and other things. It returns and picks up Peter. The Queen orders her guards to fire a cannon, which breaks the sphere apart. Everything returns, but Peter stays stuck upside down on St Paul’s Cathedral for the rest of his life. The story ends by warning not to pick your nose.

He stayed there for life, showing what can happen if you pick your nose instead of blowing it.

video_title: The World's Worst Children - Nigel Nit Boy

summaries.summary: Nigel loved nits and wanted his hair full of them. He named his first nit Mr Henderson and stopped combing his hair, so more nits joined it. He chased Tina Ting, Colin Clunt, and Minky the school cat to collect their nits. Soon his hair held millions of nits. Nigel read comics and wanted to be a super villain, so he became Nit Boy. Auntie Pat made his costume. At school, he ordered the nits to attack Mr Drumham, cover Mrs Droop with broccoli, and frighten Headmaster Mr Sour Chops. In town, the nits caused more trouble by stealing toys and stopping the police. That night, the townspeople came with combs. Nigel used the nits to lift him into the air, but they flew away when he told them to disperse. Nigel fell, was taken to a hairdresser, and had his hair washed and combed. He promised never to become Nit Boy again.

He falls, is captured, has his hair washed and combed, and promises never to be Nit Boy again.

video_title: The World's Worst Children - Miss Petula Perpetual Motion

summaries.summary: Miss Pula Perpetual Motion could never sit still. At Modesty Place, she wiggled, bounced, danced, and cartwheeled, causing many accidents. She spilled trifle, sprayed paint, released lacrosse balls, and disturbed lessons. Her head mistress, Miss PR, warned her to behave on a school trip to a porcelain museum. Professor Blink made a giant clear ball called the Bouncing Boom Boom Ball. Pula was placed inside it so she would bounce without breaking anything. At the museum, Pula bounced into the ceiling. Miss PR pushed the ball, and it bounced around the room. It broke a porcelain penguin, swan, ballerina, clown, and many other valuable pieces. The museum director made Miss PR pay millions of pounds. She had to clean, serve soup, and do other jobs at school. On Pula’s last day, Miss PR saw her sitting still and learned that Pula had always been able to stop. Then Pula cartwheeled away, scattering library books.

On her last day, she cartwheels away, scattering library books.

video_title: The World's Worst Children - Grubby Gertrude

summaries.summary: Grubby Gertrude loved being dirty. She never washed herself, her clothes, or her schoolbooks, and she dropped rubbish all over her bedroom. Soon the room was full of food, tissues, socks, and hamster droppings. Her mother, who kept the rest of the house clean, begged Gertrude to tidy it. Gertrude only laughed and shouted, “Bog off!” One day, while Gertrude was at school, Mother tried to clean the room. She could not open the door, so she pushed in the vacuum cleaner hose. The vacuum sucked up rubbish, then exploded and covered Mother in muck. That night, something growled beneath Gertrude’s rubbish. Gertrude threw more rubbish on it, but this fed the creature. A rubbish monster finally appeared. It was made from the dirty things on her floor. The monster ate all the rubbish and cleaned the room. Then it swallowed Gertrude. The story ends by saying children should tidy their rooms when grownups ask.

The rubbish broke the vacuum, covering her in filth. Later, something began moving and growling beneath Gertrude’s rubbish. She threw more waste onto it, unknowingly feeding it. The creature finally emerged as a rubbish monster made from socks, food, tissues, clothes, and other discarded items. It ate all the rubbish and grew enormous. When Gertrude tried to make it leave, the monster swallowed her. The story ends by warning children to tidy their rooms when grownups tell them to.

video_title: The World's Worst Children - Earnest Ernest

summaries.summary: Ernest was twelve years old and had never smiled or laughed. He wore gray clothes, collected pencil sharpenings, photographed traffic lights, and loved guessing what metal things were made from. He ate only cold peas and thought fun was foolish. His worried mother suggested the zoo, fairground, and circus, but Ernest refused. She took him to Professor Drooling, who used the Tickle Monster 3000, a robot with metal tentacles. It tickled Ernest harder and harder, but he did not laugh. When Professor Drooling turned the machine to danger level, it tickled him and Ernest’s mother instead. The professor hit the robot, so it tickled him until he jumped from the hospital window. The robot broke, and Ernest laughed because of the trouble. Later, Ernest became a science teacher and stayed serious for forty years. One day, an experiment exploded and a lab technician’s bottom caught fire. Ernest laughed loudly, but when the class laughed at him after he wet his trousers, he did not see the funny side.

As an adult, Ernest becomes a science teacher and remains serious until an experiment sets his assistant’s bottom on fire. Ernest laughs loudly, but the class laughs when he wets himself.

video_title: The World's Worst Children - Brian Wong

summaries.summary: Brian Wong loved maths and believed he was never ever wrong. He spent nearly all his time solving hard sums, so he became pale and wore very thick glasses. One day, his teacher, Mr Shrewdly, explained that numbers are infinite because people can always add one more. Mr Shrewdly said nobody could count to infinity, not even Brian. Brian disagreed and began counting in class. He kept counting through school, meals, and bedtime. When Kenneth Chan spoke to him and made him lose count, Brian started again at one. Brian counted for many years. He became an old man with gray hair, a long beard, and even thicker glasses. People came to watch him and called him Counting Man. On his deathbed, Kenneth visited and again made him lose count, so Brian started over. Brian never reached infinity. He died smiling because nobody had proved that he was wrong. His gravestone said he was never ever wrong about counting to infinity.

At age 111, on his deathbed, Chan again interrupted him, making him restart. Brian died without reaching Infinity, but he was never proved wrong. His gravestone claimed he was never ever wrong.

video_title: The World's Worst Children - Bertha the Blubberer

summaries.summary: Bera was an eight-year-old girl who cried about almost everything. She was unkind to her little brother, William, because she wanted all her parents’ attention. Bera often pretended that William had pinched her, so their mother punished him by taking away his pudding. William wore marshmallow earplugs and quietly read or did his homework. One day, while their parents were outside, Bera made a very bad plan. She pulled out her own hair and wanted to blame William. She pulled and pulled until she was bald except for one strand. Then her parents and William saw her. Bera tried to say that William had done it, but they had watched everything. Her parents punished her by giving her no pudding ever again. William received Bera’s puddings, and sometimes their parents’ puddings too. Bera was very unhappy as William ate them, and nobody believed her when he pinched her leg. The story says it is best to tell the truth and not blame a brother or sister.

He even pinched Bera under the table, but nobody believed her. The story ends by warning against telling lies about others.

video_title: The World's Worst Children - Dribbling Drew

summaries.summary: Drew was a very lazy boy who loved sleeping. He slept at home and at school, and he dribbled so much that puddles formed under his desk. One day, Drew’s class visited the Natural History Museum. Mr Numbing gave the children worksheets and told them to list the exhibits they saw. Drew climbed onto a case holding a stuffed dodo and fell asleep. The museum closed, but nobody noticed him. During the night, his dribble spread until it filled the whole museum. In the morning, security guard Winston opened the doors, and a huge wave of dribble swept through London. Museum exhibits, cars, buses, and people floated away. Drew woke up and climbed onto a building. He used his worksheet to write down every exhibit he saw. The next day, Mr Numbing said Drew had scored 100 percent and was top of the class. Then Drew was expelled and made to rebuild the museum’s Diplodocus skeleton. He did not sleep for ten years.

Drew woke up, climbed onto a building, and recorded every exhibit he saw on his worksheet. Mr Numbing declared him top of the class, but Drew was then expelled for destroying the museum. He was made to rebuild its Diplodocus skeleton and did not sleep for ten years.

video_title: A Day on The River

summaries.summary: Zach and his cat Sydney loved exploring the river in a canoe. Zach’s grandfather had built the canoe by hollowing out a big tree, and Zach had inherited it. One day, they passed through a beautiful village and saw a little duck sitting alone. Zach asked where its mother and brothers and sisters were. The baby duck hopped into the canoe and sat between Zach and Sydney. Zach thought the duck wanted company, so they paddled back up the river toward the bridge to look for its family. The duck watched swans float past. Under the bridge, they saw a mother goose with babies, but Zach told the duck she was not its mommy. Then Zach spotted the duck’s real mother and family. The duck flapped happily, hugged Zach, and jumped into the water. Its mother was overjoyed. Zach said helping the duck made the river day great, and Sydney purred in agreement.

The yellow Happiness Spot feels joyful and scribbles sunshine and flowers. The gray Anxiety Spot feels worried or scared, but it does not make a picture because it is afraid it will not look good. The orange Confidence Spot believes in itself and scribbles strength and determination. The red Anger Spot feels mad or hurt and scribbles chaos. Then they remember Love. Love includes caring, kindness, friendship, and respect, so the Love Spot scribbles hearts. Scribbles Spot is no longer tangled and feels better. It scribbles a rainbow. The story says every emotion is inside us and invites children to scribble their feelings with paper and crayons.

His dad explained that they had enjoyed “free fun,” a magical thing Zayn would have to find himself. The next morning, Zayn searched his house, then rode his bike around town. He looked at the pool, under bushes, and on playgrounds, but found nothing. He and his dad hiked through the forest, caves, and up a perilous peak, yet Zayn was too busy searching to enjoy the view. That night, he remembered his dad saying answers could be found while looking at waves. Zayn raced to the ocean with his surfboard. After falling beneath a powerful wave, he discovered a peaceful underwater world with seahorses and a sea turtle. He realized free fun was everywhere, not in one place. His dad agreed, explaining that it could be found by slowing down and noticing each moment. Walking home, Zayn enjoyed the ocean air, waves, and sand.

summaries.summary: Shells are hard outer coverings left when ocean animals die or move out. They come in many sizes, shapes, and colors, and some shimmer with iridescence. Calcium makes most seashells hard, and tiny shell pieces can become beach sand. Nautilus shells grow in tight walls, while snail shells spiral. Shells protect animals, but a hermit crab must move into an empty shell to protect its soft body. Some shells help animals hide by blending with sand, rocks, and plants. Decorator crabs attach living plants or animals for camouflage. Predators can still break shells. Grouper fish crush shelled animals, sea turtles eat clams, crabs, and conchs, and an octopus uses its hard beak to crunch shells. Coral reefs are made by coral polyps and shelter many ocean species, but climate change, fishing, and pollution threaten them. Pearls form around injured tissue or an irritant inside oysters. Only about one in 10,000 wild oysters has a pearl, though one giant clam pearl in the Philippines weighed 75 pounds.

summaries.summary: Shells glimmer in the summer sun and make people curious. A beach shell is the hard covering left when an ocean animal dies or leaves. Tiny shell pieces can become sand. Most shells are hard because they contain calcium. Shells come in many sizes, shapes, and colors. Some shine with changing colors, called iridescence. Nautilus shells grow in tight walls, while snail shells spiral. Shells protect animals. A hermit crab carries its soft body into an empty shell. Some animals hide because their shells match sand, rocks, or plants. Decorated crabs put living plants or animals on their shells to camouflage themselves. Shells cannot stop every predator. Grouper fish crush shelled animals with their teeth plates. Sea turtles use strong jaws, and octopuses use hard beaks, to eat crabs and other shelled animals. Coral reefs hold many shell-covered animals, but pollution, fishing, and climate change harm reefs. Sometimes oysters make pearls around an injury or irritant. A giant clam once held a 75-pound pearl, but wild pearls are very rare.

summaries.summary: A new punctuation family moved to Alphabet City. Exclamation Point led Question Mark, Period, and Comma to their first day at school. Exclamation Point was excited, Question Mark asked many questions, Period helped everyone stop, and Comma kept pausing. The letters were surprised because the family was not made of letters. Soon, the punctuation family joined the class. The letters made words, while Exclamation Point added excitement, Question Mark asked questions, and Period ended sentences. Comma began to feel small because he thought he only got in the way. He quietly left the classroom. Without Comma, the letters made words faster and faster until the words became jumbled. Period tried to stop them, but the letters fell into a heap in the hall. Comma said he thought no one wanted him. The others explained that everyone had an important job. Comma returned and stood in the middle to help keep words in order. They all learned that words need punctuation and punctuation needs words.

summaries.summary: Samuel has a bad day. He is yelled at for kicking a fence, misses his favorite pizza at lunch, and has to walk home in the rain because the bus driver misses his stop. He comes home hungry, cold, and wet. Benji, his brother, is hiding in the box they made together because he also had a bad day at preschool. When Benji has a bad day, everyone tiptoes and speaks softly, but no one does this for Samuel. Samuel tries to kick near Benji’s block city, then spills too much milk on his cereal. He cries, but no one notices. Benji comes out with his blue blanket. He wraps Samuel up tightly and calls him “my little burrito.” Samuel lets Benji into the blanket and calls him “my little brother.” Mama finds them and asks if she can join them, whether the day is good or bad. The brothers stay together side by side.

video_title: Social Emotional Learning For Kids: Benji, the Bad Day, and Me | Vooks Storytime

summaries.summary: Samuel has a terrible day. He is yelled at for kicking a fence, misses his favorite pizza at lunch, and must walk home in the rain after the bus passes his stop. Hungry, cold, and wet, he finds Benji hiding in the cardboard box they made together. Benji uses the box when he has a bad day, and everyone treats him gently. Samuel wishes he had a box too, but Mama is busy and does not notice his problems. He tries to kick above Benji’s block city, then spills milk while making cereal. He begins crying angry, sad, shivery tears. Benji comes out, spreads his blue blanket, and carefully wraps Samuel inside it. He looks at Samuel and says, “You’re my little burrito.” Samuel lets Benji into the blanket and calls him his little brother. Mama finds them and asks to join. The brothers stay together, knowing they will be okay side by side.

video_title: Kids Book Read Aloud: Luis And Tabitha! | Vooks Narrated Storybooks

summaries.summary: Louis was a brave, charming cat who lived at a fire station. One night, he met Tabitha, an elegant cat, through a glass door. They liked each other at once, but Tabitha’s owner kept chasing Louis away. Louis brought Tabitha sardine tins, twine, feathers, mice, pigeons, and even balloons. His friends told him to look like an inside cat, so Louis entered Tabitha’s home. He and Tabitha stayed together until the owner’s doorbell rang. Louis was taken away and got a new home, name, and owner, but he still wanted Tabitha. Later, while riding in the fire truck, Louis saw Tabitha in danger. He ran to help her. Louis and Tabitha came out safely, leading Tabitha’s owner. The crowd cheered. Tabitha’s owner smiled and let Louis stay. A cat show judge gave Tabitha a blue ribbon, and the firefighters gave Louis a gold medal. Louis and Tabitha were together again.

summaries.summary: Louis was a charming cat who lived at the fire station after rescuing a tiny Louise from a tall, smoky house. He traveled around town in the fire truck and was welcomed by people who gave him leftovers. One night, Louis saw Tabitha, an elegant cat, through a glass door and fell in love. He brought her sardines, twine, feathers, mice, pigeons, and even balloons, but Tabitha’s owner always chased him away. Louis asked Mr. Pickles, Socks, and One-eyed Winky for advice. He tried becoming an inside cat, but a visitor identified him, and Louis was sent away again. He returned to being a cat about town while Tabitha stayed inside. One night, Louis saw Tabitha in terrible danger during a fire. He disappeared into the crowd and came back leading Tabitha and her owner. Tabitha’s owner welcomed him, and both cats received awards. Louis and Tabitha stayed together inside.

video_title: What If You Had T.rex Teeth!? And Other Dinosaur Parts

summaries.summary: The story asks what it would be like to wake up with dinosaur body parts. T. rex teeth could bite bones and cut food. Velociraptor toes could grab prey. A Stegosaurus tail had spikes for defense. A Parasaurolophus crest helped make sounds and hear faraway deep sounds. Ankylosaurus had armor and sometimes a club tail. Brachiosaurus had a very long neck for reaching tree leaves. Therizinosaurus used its huge claws to pull branches closer. Edmontosaurus had jaws and many teeth for scooping and crushing plants. Triceratops had three horns and a bony frill. Dilophosaurus had strong, fast legs for chasing prey. Spinosaurus had a huge sail and feet suited for muddy water. These parts might be useful for a short time, but people do not need dinosaur teeth, tails, necks, or sails. People live now, not in the dinosaur age. Human body parts are just right for each person to be the one and only you.

video_title: Junebug: No Life Too Small – 🐞 Read aloud book about bugs and insects!

summaries.summary: June loves bugs and teaches her friends why small creatures are important. When Carter wants to stomp on an anthill, June explains that ants live in tunnels and work together. After rain, she moves worms from the hot sidewalk to the grass so they can return to the ground, explaining this to Max and Luke. At the barn, June stops Charlotte and Luna from tearing down spider webs and tells them that spiders catch food and eat mosquitoes. In Sierra’s pool, June rescues a beetle stuck on its back and explains that it could drown. June tells Rowan and Ambrose to watch bees instead of trapping them because bees help flowers and plants grow. At school, she catches a cricket and releases it outside for Caroline. In a field, June and Cooper take pictures of butterflies instead of catching them. That night, June watches fireflies and whispers, “Good night.”
